name: Skelton Shaft mechanical mine ventilation
description: A steam-driven Guibal fan ventilated Bell Brothers’ Skelton Shaft iron mine, with an airflow recorded in 1875.

date.label: 1875 recorded fan airflow
date.basis: This dates the scoped witness or event, not a claim of global invention.

events.statement: A steam-driven Guibal fan ventilated Bell Brothers’ Skelton Shaft iron mine, with an airflow recorded in 1875.

evidence.supports: Historic England reports a Guibal fan at Bell Brothers’ Skelton Shaft, steam-driven by two engines; in 1875 the recorded airflow was 110,000 cubic feet per minute. It replaced or supplemented a ventilation furnace.

events.caveats: The airflow is a historical reported operating figure, not independently calibrated or a measure of worker safety or mine-wide exposure. The fanhouse dates from about 1870; the 1875 record anchors the measurement.
